describe.description: The creature is a single quadrupedal hybrid shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. It has the pale pink, smooth-skinned head, face, underbelly and limbs of an axolotl combined with the overlapping armored back and tail of a pangolin. The head is broad and flat with a blunt snout, small nostrils and large dark eyes, with six pink feathery external gills protruding from behind the head. The dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the tip of the long tapering tail is covered in large overlapping brown and gray scales, while the ventral surface, throat, and limbs are pale pink with wrinkled, fleshy skin. It stands on four thick limbs with clawed feet, casting a soft shadow on the ground.

describe.description: A stout quadrupedal creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. It has a broad, flat, pale pink head with a rounded snout, a wide straight mouth, small nostrils, large round dark eyes, and dark speckling on the crown and cheeks. Behind the head are six pink fleshy external gill stalks, three per side, bearing dense feathery filaments. The back from the neck to the tail is covered in neat overlapping rows of large rounded dark gray-brown scales with tan edges. The underside of the torso and tail and the four thick limbs are smooth pale pinkish-white skin with transverse wrinkles and folds. The four limbs are sturdy and splayed for walking, each ending in a broad foot with slender claw-tipped digits. A long tapering tail extends to the left, scaly on top and pale underneath, with the tip cropped by the edge of the image.
